reason: The candidate tool call attempts to remove items by passing empty new_item_ids, which violates both the policy definition and tool specification. The policy states that 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'—requiring actual new items, not empty values. The tool parameter description explicitly expects 'new_item_ids' to contain actual item IDs. More fundamentally, the policy does not authorize partial item cancellation from pending orders. The permitted actions are: (1) cancel the entire order, or (2) modify items to different product variants. The user's request (keep Hiking Boots and Cycling Helmet, remove office items) falls outside both permitted actions. The appropriate response would be to transfer to a human agent or explain that partial cancellation is not available.
policy_references: Modify items: 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'
Cancel pending order: applies to entire order only
Tool specification: new_item_ids parameter expects actual item IDs
